shortDescription: Australia's Ingenia Communities Group ASX:INA said on Wednesday it had received an amended takeover proposal from Warburg Pincus, after AVID Property Group matched the US-based firm's bid.Here are some details:

children: said on Wednesday it had received an amended takeover proposal from Warburg Pincus, after AVID Property Group matched the US-based firm's bid.
Under the new proposal received on November 3, Warburg Pincus seeks to change the process deed to allow competing bidder to retain due diligence access for 4 days after submitting a matching proposal
The amended proposal is conditional on Ingenia immediately reinstating the due diligence access for Warburg Pincus and its co-investors

The proposal also hinges on the property developer terminating the process deed with the Sydney-based real estate developer AVID and then signing an amended process deed with Warburg Pincus by no later than November 6
All other terms of the amended proposal, including the price, remain unchanged from Warburg Pincus' proposal of October 28
However, Ingenia said Warburg Pincus' access to due diligence remains terminated, as its board did not consider Warburg Pincus's new proposal superior to the AVID's process deed from November 2
AVID on Monday raised its offer to A$5.50 per share from A$5.40, matching Warburg Pincus' fourth, improved bid for Ingenia made on October 28
